interpretation: Bred vectors should have higher subspace projection AND faster tangent-linear growth than random.
note: Toth-Kalnay 1993 canonical test is tangent-linear growth: bred vectors, having been iteratively rescaled through the true dynamics, sit in the finite-time optimal subspace and grow faster than random. QR-Benettin backward Lyapunov vectors are not necessarily the same subspace on finite windows.
